I did not want to leave this hidden little gem of a real English pub/music Bar.
Jul 2025 • Solo
The Cheeky Traveller, Phu Quoc is the best live music venue in Vietnam. 
Their prices are amazing and so are their drinks, food and bands! (Amazing solo act from 7pm and a different live band every single night later at 9pm.) 
The whole team Kim, Ken, Bo, Kahnh and Dia really are the stars of the show every single night of the week. Their impeccable table service keeps a drink in your hand all night and you’ll be shocked how low your bill is at the end of the night. 
Everything I drank and ate there was just fantastic and if you have any special preferences they serve it exactly how you like it every time. 
There is bike parking and easy access for grab pick up and drop offs. 
All the staff speak great English and are the friendliest staff on the whole island. 
I spent almost every night there on my visit to the island and they are all so warm they make everyone feel like family. The atmosphere there is absolutely electric. 
If you’re a musician, singer or just like to sing along they are happy to get the band to let you join in and have percussion instruments that they always let the customers use. That said, the bands are not just jamming, they are such skilled musicians you’ll feel you’re at an event of real Vietnamese and English stars. 
If you’re on the island, do not miss out on the Cheeky Bar.
